name: Astro Open-Source Static Website Framework
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed open-source framework for building and locally generating static content-focused websites; no software-imposed site or build quota.
watch_out: Astro core is free software, not an included hosting, CDN or serverless allowance. Hosting, domain, bandwidth, CI and optional server-side rendering adapters or third-party integrations may incur costs; respect dependency licenses.
